# Cosmotion
Inclusive, motion-based space-learning games. No build step, no dependencies.

## Play modes
Mouse/touch · Webcam motion (runs locally, no video leaves the device) · One-key switch access

## Accessibility
Hold-to-select (dwell), adjustable speed/size/hold time, high contrast, calm mode, read-aloud, no fail states.

## Deploy on GitHub Pages
Push these files to a repo → Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch `main` / root.
(Webcam needs HTTPS, which Pages provides.)

## Add a game
Add an entry to `GAMES` and a branch in `makeRound()` in `app.js`.
